titel: Why You Should Never Smash Your Pond Ice

beats.say: Why should you never smash the ice... on your *pond?*
It's freezing, and Rudi panics. His *frogs* are stuck under the ice!
So Rudi grabs a *hammer.* Down below, the frogs see stars.
It freezes again, so Rudi brings a *jackhammer.* Now the pond has a hole.
Some frogs *sleep* on the pond floor all winter. They breathe through their skin.
Smashing the ice sends *shock waves* through the water. That can kill them.
The real danger? Rotting leaves make *toxic gas*, trapped under the ice.
Instead, set a pan of *hot water* on the ice, and let it melt a hole.
So before you grab that hammer this winter... ask yourself:
